sources.title: Akamai Technologies Form 8-K, September 24, 2026 (Anthropic Master Services Agreement and warrant)

event.title: Anthropic and Akamai cloud capacity contracts
event.summary: Anthropic signed two project plans with Akamai for dedicated cloud computing capacity, each with an initial seven-year term. Akamai also issued Anthropic a warrant to buy its preferred stock.

amounts.label: Aggregate commitment under the two project plans
amounts.condition: Subject to termination rights and to delivery and service availability requirements
amounts.quote: Subject to any termination described below and satisfaction of certain delivery and service availability requirements, Anthropic has committed to pay the Company approximately $11.6 billion in the aggregate under the Project Plans.

amounts.label: Warrant exercise price per Series B preferred share
amounts.quote: at an exercise price of $2,226.60 per Warrant Share

quantities.label: Warrant shares (Series B non-voting convertible preferred)
quantities.quote: the Company issued to Anthropic a warrant (the "Warrant") to purchase up to 387,051 shares (the "Warrant Shares") of the Company's Series B Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock

facts.label: Term
facts.text: Each project plan has an initial seven-year term from its service start date.
facts.quote: Each Project Plan has an initial seven-year term commencing on their respective service start dates.

facts.label: Framework
facts.text: The project plans sit under a master services agreement dated May 5, 2026.
facts.quote: under the existing Master Services Agreement between the Company and Anthropic, dated as of May 5, 2026

facts.label: Warrant vesting
facts.text: The warrant vests in four tranches tied to additional contract value from Anthropic.
facts.quote: The Warrant will vest and become exercisable in four tranches based upon the commitment by Anthropic to the Company of additional commercial contractual value
